Name: Light Bolt
Components: V, S, M (a note claiming superiority)
Description: Sometimes what matters most isn’t to cause the most destruction, but to make sure your will finds its way through any shade. You summon an orb of light atop an enemy within range, performing a ranged spell attack against them as lighting lances rain down on them. You have a +2 modifier to hit with this spell and it deals 2d6 radiant damage.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you deal an additional 1d4 damage and have an additional +1 modifier to hit for each slot level above 1st.
